facts.claim: Genevieve 拒绝报警，说自己不想让事态升级。
Samuel 让女婿 Dan 留在屋里陪 Genevieve，自己和 Abi 出门去查看。
facts.quote: “Dan, you stay here. Genny needs the moral support.”

facts.claim: Abi 用遥控钥匙打开一辆 Prius，与 Samuel 坐进前排，叙述者溜进后座跟随。
facts.quote: Abi used a remote clicker to open a Prius sedan.

facts.claim: 叙述者在车上给 Luke 回短信，答应见面但说不好明天会怎样。
facts.quote: Love to, I wrote back. But TBH it’s hard to know what tmrw will bring.

facts.claim: 夜班保安 Alberto 告诉 Abi，Deirdre 几分钟前乘 Uber 到门口，报了真名并已被通报给 Rose。
facts.quote: Alberto says she showed up in the Uber a few minutes ago.

facts.claim: Deirdre 站在栅栏外，恳求 Abi 让她见 Genevieve 五分钟。
facts.quote: But if I could just see her, even for just like five minutes?

facts.claim: Deirdre 被 Abi 逼问时喊出 Genevieve 有危险。
Abi 念出 Deirdre 的手机号，让在场所有人记下并拉黑。
facts.quote: “Take this down,” instructed Abi, reading out a ten-digit number.

relations.rel: 父女——Samuel 当着众人称 Genevieve 为 my daughter
relations.quote: “Then what did you mean?” he asked quietly. “How is my daughter in danger?”

relations.rel: 夫妻——Dan 是 Samuel 的女婿，扶 Genevieve 上楼
relations.quote: Dan, you stay here. Genny needs the moral support.

relations.rel: 胜似父女——Abi 哭时靠在这个「一辈子像家长一样待她」的男人身上
relations.quote: He patted her arm while turning back to Deirdre.

relations.rel: 加害者与受害者——Deirdre 当年把 Genevieve 囚禁，如今来求见
relations.quote: as she begged to see the person who had been the means of keeping her locked away for so long

relations.rel: 代笔人——叙述者自称是 Genevieve 回忆录的 ghostwriter
relations.quote: the ghostwriter of Genevieve Caraway’s memoir

relations.rel: 约会对象——Luke 发短信约第二天晚饭，叙述者回信赴约
relations.quote: Nice meeting you today. Dinner tomorrow (Sat)?

numbers.claim: 叙述者拿「坐二十年牢」调侃 Deirdre 出狱后的外貌变化
numbers.quote: Should we all be spending twenty years in prison, reader?

numbers.claim: 叙述者为赶飞机凌晨四点半起床
numbers.quote: I’d woken up at four thirty in the morning to get to the airport

numbers.claim: 叙述者估算此刻纽约时间已过午夜
numbers.quote: and it was past midnight now in New York

numbers.claim: Dan 说 La Dorada Inn 离这里约十五分钟车程
Deirdre 的手机号是十位数
Abi 至少比 Samuel 高两英寸
numbers.quote: who was at least two inches taller than him

numbers.claim: Deirdre 把求见时长从五分钟降到两分钟
numbers.quote: even for just like five minutes? Two minutes.

numbers.claim: Uber 司机做了一个急促的三点掉头离开
numbers.quote: He executed a hasty three-point turn

numbers.claim: 叙述者把 Deirdre 的肌肉比作《终结者2》里的 Linda Hamilton
numbers.quote: à la the incarcerated Linda Hamilton in Terminator 2

turning_point: Deirdre 在栅栏外被逼到无路可退时喊出「Genevieve is in danger!」，这场「赶走不速之客」的对峙立刻变成「有人要害 Genevieve」的悬念。
notes: 1) Abi 回屋后对 Genevieve 说 Deirdre「只是来道歉」，但叙述者当场质疑：Deirdre 从未明说道歉。2) Deirdre 所说的「危险」具体所指全章未交代，Abi 与 Samuel 都没能问出内容；Samuel 反问「Is that a threat?」她也否认。3) 引语含弯引号、破折号、重音符号（à、¡），range 均由 text.index 逐字定位。
